Flat miles for wheels.alt: A wooden boardwalk bridge and a paved crushed-shell trail curve along the water's edge at Robinson Preserve, with mangroves and the Sunshine Skyway Bridge in the distance and a few distant walkers on the path
Flat miles for wheels.caption: The paved trail and boardwalk bridge at Robinson Preserve, with the Sunshine Skyway Bridge beyond.
Flat miles for wheels.author: Mark Hewitt
Flat miles for wheels.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
Flat miles for wheels.verification: Wikimedia Commons file (an archived Panoramio upload) titled "Robinson Perserve" [sic], categorized under "Robinson Preserve," with an embedded geotag (27.512839, -82.668686) inside the preserve; shows the preserve's own paved and boardwalk trail network with the Sunshine Skyway Bridge visible beyond, matching this pick's "crushed-shell and paved paths" and the guide's own mention of views to the Skyway. Taken 28 November 2009 per file metadata; the trail infrastructure shown is long-lived park amenity, distinct from the observation-tower photo already used for a different pick in this guide. Distant walkers on the trail are incidental and not the subject. Live Commons licence checked: CC BY-SA 3.0.
